title: Agent used external tools after context compaction without buffering MissingMoebTool signals
description: After conversation compaction, the agent resumed work using Claude Code's Read, Edit, and Bash tools to investigate and fix the run_command test race condition, without buffering MissingMoebTool signals as required by the tool-origin policy. All operations had moeb equivalents (read_file, patch_file, run_command).
proposed_resolution: After context compaction, re-read the run skill's Tool Origin Policy section to re-establish the signal-buffering obligation before using external tools. Consider adding a compaction-resume reminder in run.skill.md.
